releaseGate.meaning: A provenance gate, not a legal determination. Source-linked drawings/recipes are recorded evidence, not proof of exclusive rights or visual non-infringement.

legacyDimensionManifest.note: Legacy manifest records replacement target dimensions/durations and historical byte counts. It is not a complete current inventory or permission record.

runtime.scope: Local literal URLs, literal constants, declared bounded catalogs, and squeeze JSON. Not a browser crawl or arbitrary template/database URL evaluation.

historicalInputs.reason: Exact historical value in a banner-image migration WHERE clause.
